title: Mediterranean Chickpea & Haloumi Stew
subtitle: with Fetta, Carrot Couscous & Rocket
description: This herby chickpea and veggie packed dinner delight will have you salivating for more! Soak up all richness and depth of this tempting dish with a bed of fluffy carrot couscous.

steps.text:
•

• In a medium bowl, place haloumi and cover with water to soak.
• Finely chop or crush garlic. Thinly slice onion. Grate carrot.
• Drain and rinse half the chickpeas.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil and 1/2 the garlic over medium-high heat. Cook until fragrant, 1 min.
• Transfer to a small bowl. Stir in Greek-style yoghurt. Season with salt and pepper to taste and set aside.

•

• In a medium saucepan, melt 1/2 the butter with a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook remaining garlic and 1/2 the carrot, stirring, until softened, 2-3 mins.
• Add the water (for the couscous) and stock powder and bring to the boil.
• Stir in couscous. Cover and remove from heat. Set aside until water is absorbed, 5 mins. Fluff up with a fork.

•

• Drain haloumi and pat dry. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices.
• Meanwhile,wash and dry the frying pan, then return to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Cook haloumi until golden brown, 1-2 mins each side.Transfer to a plate.
• Return frying pan to high heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Cook onion, chickpeas and the remaining carrot until tender, 4-5 mins.
• Reduce heat to medium-high and add tomato & herb seasoning and passata. Cook, stirring until fragrant, 1-2 mins. 
• Stir in the water (for the stew), brown sugar and remaining butter and cook until slightly thickened, 1-2 mins. Season to taste.

•

• In a medium bowl, combine rocket leaves and a drizzle of vinegar and olive oil. Season to taste.
• Divide carrot couscous and rocket between bowls.
• Top couscous with Mediterranean stew and cooked haloumi. Drizzle with garlic yoghurt. Crumble over fetta cubes to serve.
